status.text:
Black Friday Premarket movers:

All Mag 7s lower: http://Amazon.com (AMZN) plunges 7.3% as growth in the company’s Amazon Web Services cloud-computing business was seen as underwhelming; Nvidia (NVDA) -2.8%, Tesla (TSLA) -2.4%, Meta Platforms (META) -1.8%, Apple (AAPL) -1.1%, Alphabet (GOOGL) -0.7%, Microsoft (MSFT) -0.6%. Here are some of the other notable premarket movers:

AI infrastructure stocks tumble following discouraging results from Amazon and Intel.

Cryptocurrency-linked stocks slide after Binance suffered the industry’s biggest-ever hack in a fresh blow to efforts to push digital assets into the mainstream.

Alphatec (ATEC) plunges 33% after the medical devices company reported third quarter revenue that missed the average analyst estimate.

Coursera (COUR) drops 9% after the nline educational firm provided a disappointing forecast for fourth quarter revenue.

DXC Technology (DXC) falls 12% after the IT services company cut its adjusted earnings per share guidance for the full year. The company also said there are ongoing talks for the possible sale of its insurance business.

FedEx Freight (FDXF), which was spun off from FedEx Corp. in June, climbs 4% after posting revenue of $3.3 billion in the four months ending in September, an increase of 9.2% over the same period last year.

Gilead Sciences (GILD) rises 4% after the biopharmaceutical company boosted its product sales guidance for the full year.

Intel (INTC) plummets 25% after the chipmaker’s outlook was much weaker than expected, due in part to sluggishness in PCs.

Mondelez International (MDLZ) is up 7% after the company said it would acquire a majority stake in Undercover Snacks, bolstering the better-for-you part of its portfolio.

Newell Brands (NWL) falls 11% after the household-products maker narrowed its normalized earnings per share forecast for the full year.

Pinterest (PINS) falls 8% after the social-media company reported revenue for the third quarter that missed the average analyst estimate.

Reddit (RDDT) tumbles 20% after daily active users for the third quarter and a fourth-quarter revenue forecast missed expectations. Analysts also debated a plan to limit access to its forums to users with accounts.

Regeneron (REGN) climbs 7% after the drugmaker posted revenue and adjusted profit for the third quarter that are ahead of Wall Street’s expectations.

Rivian (RIVN) jumps 6% after the maker of electric vehicles reported revenue for the third quarter that beat the average analyst estimate.

Roblox (RBLX) slides 18% as the company reported a year-over-year decline in player engagement after deploying more robust child-safety measures.

Stryker (SYK) falls 11% after slashing its outlook as the medical device company struggles to shake off the lingering effects of a cyberattack.

Symbotic (SYM) inches 2% higher after robotics technology firm expanded an agreement with retail giant Walmart.

Twilio (TWLO) is down 18% in the latest example of a software stock tumbling in the wake of results as investors reassess the sector’s growth outlook amid growing AI adoption.
